terminals.name: api
terminals.description: FastAPI investigation service (main:app) on port 8000. GET / for a health check; POST /investigate to run the agent.
terminals.command: source .venv/bin/activate && DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=5432 DB_NAME=agent_db DB_USER=agent_user DB_PASSWORD=agent_password exec uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

terminals.name: mcp
terminals.description: MCP server exposing get_metrics and search_runbook over streamable-http on port 8001.
terminals.command: source .venv/bin/activate && DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=5432 DB_NAME=agent_db DB_USER=agent_user DB_PASSWORD=agent_password PORT=8001 exec python -m app.mcp_server
